title: Subnet discovery is on by default from v1.18 — secondary ENIs can land in other subnets tagged kubernetes.io/role/cni

detection.reason: ENABLE_SUBNET_DISCOVERY's VALUE is not collected; subnet tags and the CNI role's IAM policy are AWS-side

remediation: From v1.18 ipamd picks, per new secondary ENI, the subnet with the most free IPs among the node's own subnet and subnets in its VPC/AZ tagged kubernetes.io/role/cni (ENABLE_SUBNET_DISCOVERY defaults to true), so pods can get IPs from those subnets — check their route tables, NACLs and security-group expectations. Discovery calls ec2:DescribeSubnets: on v1.18–v1.21 a denied call falls back to the node's subnet, but from v1.22 a failed call stops ENI creation (see the 1.22 rule). Grant ec2:DescribeSubnets to the CNI role, or set ENABLE_SUBNET_DISCOVERY=false to keep the old behaviour.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[] | .name as $c | .env[]? | select(.name | test("^(ENABLE_SUBNET_DISCOVERY)$")) | "\($c): \(.name)=\(.value // "(from \(.valueFrom | keys | join(",")))")"'  # absent or true = discovery on: subnets tagged kubernetes.io/role/cni in the node's VPC/AZ can host pod IPs
coversNotes: Bugfix - updating iam doc with subnet policy

title: The ENIConfig CRD gains a schema (v1.18.3): spec.subnet becomes required, unknown spec fields are pruned

detection.reason: ENIConfig objects are not collected yet

quote: Update the APISpec Schema definition for ENIConfig.
remediation: After the CRD from the v1.18.3+ chart/manifest is applied, the API server validates ENIConfigs: an ENIConfig without spec.subnet is rejected on its next write, and spec fields other than subnet/securityGroups are pruned. Fix such objects before applying the new CRD.
verifyCommand: kubectl get eniconfigs -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select((.spec.subnet // "") == "" or ((.spec | keys) - ["subnet","securityGroups"] | length) != 0) | .metadata.name'  # each ENIConfig printed lacks spec.subnet or carries spec fields the v1.18.3 schema prunes
